integrity: Analytic proof and an independent finite numerical checker included; no assertion of external certification.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three independent boundary points and the area centroid of a nondegenerate Euclidean triangle. Not a theorem for arbitrary polygons, off-centroid points, dependent samples, or the triangle-area distribution. The stability coefficient is valid but not claimed sharp; historical priority remains provisional.
title: Sharp centroid-containment law for arclength-sampled triangle boundaries
